stated: Passing a new Environmental Rights Act, recognising everyone’s human right to a healthy environment and guaranteeing access to environmental justice. Making sure that the UK has the highest environmental standards in the world.

source.quote: Passing a new Environmental Rights Act, recognising everyone’s human right to a healthy environment and guaranteeing access to environmental justice. Making sure that the UK has the highest environmental standards in the world.

bearing_set.reason: The core commitment to 'highest environmental standards in the world' directly bears on air quality, water quality and emissions trajectory — the clean-environment fundamentals.

The policy explicitly creates a new legal right (human right to a healthy environment) and guarantees 'access to environmental justice' — new enforceable civil rights and due-process mechanisms fall squarely within O9's legal-rights and access-to-justice scope.

A 'highest standards in the world' regulatory commitment imposes compliance costs on UK businesses (near-term drag on investment and productivity) but may also drive clean-tech innovation and durable competitiveness — a real dual-horizon O13 tradeoff that economists actively contest.

membership_note: Three fundamentals: O6 is the primary target; O9 is genuinely engaged via the rights-and-justice access mechanism; O13 carries a real near-term vs long-term regulatory-burden tradeoff on business investment and living standards.
